nodes.name: Is PR Opened?
nodes.notes: Only proceed for newly opened PRs.

nodes.name: Extract PR Info
nodes.notes: Extracts PR number, title, repo and branch from webhook payload.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ body: '> 🤖 **This is an automated message from the DevLLMOps AI Agent**

**Starting AI code review for PR #' + $json.pr_number + '.**

<details>
<summary>View details</summary>

- **PR:** #' + $json.pr_number + ' — ' + $json.pr_title + '
- **Branch:** `' + $json.head_branch + '`

Fetching diff and running analysis...

</details>' }) }}

nodes.name: Post Starting Comment
nodes.notes: Posts initial comment acknowledging the PR review has started.

nodes.name: Get Changed Files
nodes.notes: Retrieves the list of files changed in the PR for security path detection.

nodes.name: Get Full Diff
nodes.notes: Fetches the full PR diff (as unified diff). Timeout 60s for large PRs.

nodes.name: Check Security Paths
nodes.notes: Truncates diff to 50K chars and passes through PR context.

nodes.name: Fetch CLAUDE.md
nodes.notes: Fetches CLAUDE.md from the PR branch for project context. Non-fatal if missing.

nodes.name: Fetch REVIEW.md
nodes.notes: Fetches REVIEW.md from the PR branch for review guidelines. Non-fatal if missing (falls back to defaults).

nodes.name: Build Claude Body
nodes.notes: Decodes CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, and TEAM.md from base64. Builds Claude prompt with project context, review guidelines, and team context. Falls back to default checklist if REVIEW.md is absent.

nodes.name: Claude Review
nodes.notes: Calls Claude Haiku for code review. Timeout 120s, retries 3x with 5s backoff.

nodes.name: Build Review Comment
nodes.notes: Parses Claude's SUMMARY/details. Builds comment with AI header. Dynamically determines require_human from CLAUDE.md security paths and resolves reviewers from TEAM.md routing table.

nodes.name: Post Review Comment
nodes.notes: Posts the AI code review comment on the PR.

nodes.name: Needs Human Review?
nodes.notes: Routes to human review request if security-critical paths were touched (per CLAUDE.md), otherwise auto-approves.

nodes.name: Request Human Review
nodes.notes: Requests review from the appropriate team members based on TEAM.md review routing.

nodes.name: Approve PR
nodes.notes: Auto-approves the PR when no security-critical paths are touched and AI review found no issues. May fail with 422 if the same account opened the PR (GitHub limitation); the ai-review-passed label provides the signal instead.

nodes.name: Add Label
nodes.notes: Adds ai-review-passed label to signal that the AI review passed without issues.

nodes.name: Fetch TEAM.md
nodes.notes: Fetches TEAM.md from the PR branch for reviewer routing. Non-fatal if missing.
